title: Case workflow labels
summary: Case status, priority and Shelter case type now read as Title Case labels on APES CIC and Shelter case screens and emails.
changes: APES CIC case lists, details and selects show statuses such as Waiting on User and priorities such as Urgent.
Shelter case lists, details and selects show statuses such as In Review and case types such as Surrender.
Case update emails and Shelter dashboard items use the same labels.
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.43 line: display labels only, with no data, validation or permission change.
validation: CaseWorkflowLabelsTest covers APES CIC and Shelter screens, selects and both update emails.
Existing Shelter and APES CIC case workflow tests.
composer pre-merge on the pull request branch.
known_limitations: APES CIC case categories keep their existing settings-driven names.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No database change is involved.
